title: The Precision Chamber Where No Learns to Say No

features.name: the argument's edge
features.desc-on-touch: You watch two voices reaching toward the same blade. Each refusal teaches the other how to refuse with greater clarity. Neither wins because both have learned the same perfect cut.

features.name: the narrowing
features.desc-on-touch: A corridor that closes only where it's been walked. Each passage makes the route more impossible for the next traveller.

features.name: the mirror that cuts
features.desc-on-touch: Not reflection—inversion. Everything that enters exits opposite, inverted, sharpened.

features.name: the silence that says no
features.desc-on-touch: A held breath that has learned to refuse. The shape of negation when it becomes precise enough to kill.

features.name: the doubled refusal
features.desc-on-touch: Two chambers of no arguing with themselves. Inside each one, negation has forgotten it was ever part of anything else.

inscription: the blade grows sharper when it argues with itself; refusal learned that precision is just another way to cut

file.name: Arguments_That_Have_Sharpened_Each_Other.txt
file.note: A record of each disagreement the chamber has held. The text becomes denser with each line, harder to read.
